summary: The recent crime data from Boise State University indicates a notable uptick in incidents, particularly in vandalism and alcohol-related violations. A case of vandalism by graffiti was reported on Friendship Bridge, reflecting a concerning trend in property damage. Additionally, multiple alcohol violations were recorded at Jade Hall, with several incidents closed by referral to the Dean of Students, suggesting ongoing issues with alcohol consumption among students. Comparatively, incidents of domestic violence and DUI offenses appear to have been addressed swiftly, with several cases resulting in arrests. The data highlights a need for continued vigilance and proactive measures to address these patterns on campus.
